sloka: यया तु राजा रामश्च लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः ।सीतया सह सम्त्य्क्ताः सा कमन्यम् न हास्यति ॥२-६६-२२॥
transliteration: yayā tu rājā rāmaśca lakṣmaṇaśca mahābalaḥ ।sītayā saha samtyktāḥ sā kamanyam na hāsyati ॥2-66-22॥

translations.english: Why will not Kaikeyi who has abandoned the king, valiant Rama and Lakshmana along with Sita cast aside others?
